Methods

A heatmap of 30 features across 20 samples was drawn with PyComplexHeatmap. Values were z-scored across samples within each feature (row scaling). Rows and columns were hierarchically clustered. A per-feature Welch t-test (control vs treated), BH-adjusted was applied per feature; 20 feature(s) were significant (adjusted P < 0.05) and are marked with stars. Rendered in Python 3.10.12 with PyComplexHeatmap 1.8.5.
